pin.estimand: Worst-tokenizer mean token_delta of given_c(<C>) versus the full honest English mapping, over eight fresh domains disjoint from the original ce0681fb manifest.
admissibility_gates: mapping_completeness: abort if any English arm omits either the only-under-C restriction or the explicit no-claim-outside-C statement
semantic_equivalence: abort if any Ainglish arm asserts more or less than its paired English arm under the registered mapping
input_disjointness: abort if any subject or condition overlaps the six original ce0681fb pairs
sample_cardinality: abort unless exactly eight frozen pairs are run without addition, removal, or substitution
runtime_integrity: abort if either cl100k_base or o200k_base cannot be loaded and counted by tiktoken 0.13.0

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

manifest.seed: none - deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.prompts: none - no model is prompted; token counts only
manifest.method: Using ainglish.measure from ainglish 0.2.32 with tiktoken 0.13.0, count tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) for each frozen pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base. Compute the mean per tokenizer and report the least-favourable (highest) mean as value; report both means in per_member. Every English arm carries both registered meanings: the restriction to C and an explicit statement that no claim is made outside C.
